nom: The INKEY List Salicylic Acid Acne + Blackhead Cleanser

avis.titre: The best SA cleanser I have ever used
avis.texte: This product is by far the best Salicylic acid cleanser I have ever used. It is very hydrating and gentle. The only SA cleanser that has not dryed my skin out. It's gentle enough to be used daily and it has cleared my acne a lot.

Blackheads have always been an insecurity of mine. they're really visible on my nose. I started using this face wash a few months ago. I don't use it everyday, I rotate it with some other ones, but since incorporating it into my line-up I've seen a noticeable difference to my nose. My pores appear smaller and less clogged. The cleanser doesn't feel greasy or heavy, doesn't leave a residue. You don't need to use a lot to get a good lather or need to use morning and night. This is a really successful product.

This works great on my hormonal acne. I have tried other acne spot treatments, both drug store and higher-end, but this is definitely the best. It doesn't leave a white cast on skin where applied, it doesn't dry skin out, and it clears breakouts quickly.
Salicylic acid cleanser that doesn't dry out your skin and keeps the pores clean

This is a great treatment for hyperpigmentation, I love that the inkey list products don't have a sticky feeling and ACTUALLY melt into my skin! They also don't have horrible perfumes in them and smell neutral! I am currently using all Inkey list products and have been for the last 3-4 years! The skin quiz and online support have helped me clean up my acne!

It actually works, and fast. At home you can leave a dot of the product on the spots (it works the fastest) or if you don't want to have a green spot on the face you can smudge it in over areas with acne. Perfect for big pimples, I use it 2-3 times a day for fastest results.

Firstly, why is this not a bestseller? Secondly, yes, it works! Almost instantly it reduces blemishes and stops any of those nasty spots we all get from progressing. I am SO GUTTED that they no longer have the Mandelic Acid Treatment in production because this works hand in hand and has been THE ONLY thing that helped with removing scars so quickly. Bring it back PLEASE.

avis.titre: I have hormonal spots and PD- New fav in ance spot care
avis.texte: Saw an ad for this and looked into it more. The ingredients looked good but I'm always nervous to try new stuff because I have sensitive and reactive skin, prone to dermatitis from random products. Let me just say, this has been amazing for me. I put it under my nose where I tend to get PD spots, on hormonal cyst acne they pops up, and any where needed, and have had no bad reactions. It does dry the acne area a little bit but that's to be expected with these ingredients and daily use. I used it on a big, under the skin cyst. It made the cyst slowly go down and its stay was shorter than it would have been. I also tried using it under makeup and it didn't make any skincare or makeup pill up. Highly recommend and will rebuy, and that will take a while because a little goes a long way.
Honestly just a great cleanser overall. It always leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed ‚Äî def sticking to this and Inkey list
It calms down inflammation and minimises imperfections without causing dryness
Love this! Does not irritate my skin but exfoliates enough to fight the dullness. Can be used morning and night which I love
It leaves a smooth skin after usage, although my skin hasn't improved and the breakouts still occur

I really like this salicylic acid cleanser because it leaves my skin feeling completely clean and refreshed. It does a great job at controlling breakouts and excess oil. Since it can be a bit drying, I always make sure to hydrate and protect my skin afterwards. Overall, it's very effective and has become an important step in my routine.

I bought this from Inkey's website not ulta, and i can tell you the reviews there are not as high as they are here. Probably because *someone* decided to be shady and add reviews for the cleanser instead of the actual product hoping people wouldn't actually read the reviews. I gave this stuff about a month of using and it did literally nothing for my pimples. Gave it to my husband and didnt work for his either. Theres was better products out there for the same price. Dont waste your money

I've always struggled with finding a cleanser that consistently works for my skin, and this has been my favorite for a few years now. Always sharing it with friends! Feels light and doesn't leave my skin feeling tight and dry like others I've tried. Definitely helping with normal breakouts, and even noticing a difference in cystic acne that comes with my cycle.
You don't need an active in your cleanser because it's just going down the sink, but this one is great
This one really balances out the PH from my skin, taking away all the unwanted oiliness. I recommend it!
Works wonders against acne overnight, absolutely a must-have.

I don't break out as much as I used to but I love having this on hand when I do. Especially around my favorite week of the month when my chin goes crazy with small breakouts. It helps clear the small ones up fast and while it may not help in that aspect with the larger, more painful ones, it does help bring the pain down on those to the point that I forget that they're there. Definitely don't want to be without this anymore.

avis.titre: replacing facetheory Blemicalm with this product
avis.texte: Reduced some raised spots quickly. Also does not smell like sulphur. Yay. Good price, too.

avis.titre: A great daily/every other day cleanser
avis.texte: This is a gentle exfoliating cleanser that doesn't bother my sensitive skin. In the summer I tend to use it every other day and it's especially great when I'm removing waterproof sunscreen. I was also recommended it to use as an underarm wash on super sweaty days to help control odour but I haven't tried it yet. It's got a nice gel texture, no fragrance, and it rinses easily.
Definitely cleanses your skin. I'm not sure at how effective it is at actually dealing with blemishes as product is not on your skin for a long amount of time.

avis.titre: I'm on my 3rd bottle - 5 stars for sure
avis.texte: When I first used this cleanser, I wasn't sure it did anything. It wasn't the cleanser recommended to me, I just wanted something that would keep closed comedones at bay. Now, I can feel the difference in texture if I skip it for a few mornings in a row. It's gentle, but does the work! I like to really massage it into my face and leave it on for at least 30 seconds, as opposed to just lathering it on and washing it off, and this was when I started to first notice a difference.

I used this in holiday * temperature was 32 * I usually get spots due to the sweat and all the extra spf but not one appeared.. I doubled cleansed as always at night and it never made my skin feel dry .. just really clean and fresh and no spots ..
I know longer have blackheads and haven't had a break out of spots for a good while . It took a while for my skin to get better , but it has now definitely improved.
had a really good result skin got better in less that 2 weeks!
I am officially obsessed with this cleaner. It doesn't dry out my face at all, have been using it since 2023.
Works great for my white heads and stubborn clogged pores. I will be purchasing again.
Good for removing makeup. I use twice in the evening to remove all excess
I use this as my second cleanser. It works great at preventing breakouts and it doesn't dry out my skin. I do wish it had a pump so I took off a star.

I like how this cleanser foams up, it feels like it's giving me a decent cleanse without drying my skin out too much. It's fragrance free but I guess the ingredients themselves have a slight scent, which is kind of sterile, hospital smelling. but it's super faint!

Repeat purchase for my teen son, has really helped clear his skin and keep it spot free. Never thought id get him in a consistent skincare routine but he has seen the results and uses it everyday. The packaging is great aswell for him as probably wouldn't use it if it was in a fancy bottle!
I bought this for my daughter and it helps getting rid of pimples without burning and pinching sensations.

I got my husband using this as well and his skin has been staying clear. Unfortunately, it doesnt seem to help with my hormonal chin/jaw acne, however i like that it washes off my makeup well and i like the lather consistency its thin but not *too* thin. Also its rare to find S products that dont overly strip your skin and make u flaky. I will continue to buy this

I gave this 2 stars purely for the fact that the green tint does help neutralize some redness. However, i do not find this helps clear acne at all. Ive been using consistently and pimples look just as bad the next morning. I dont feel like this works for me
This cleanser is a game changer! I suffered with constant break outs, I've been using this for well over a year now and I only get the off spot around my time of the month.

I see a lot of reviews on this product talking about a cleanser, something that this is not. This is an acne treatment. I use it as a spot treatment for individual zits, or sometimes an area treatment for when I have whole sections of my face breaking out. What I've noticed is that my acne goes away over the course of a few days. This is an excellent and affordable option for a spot treatment.
I don't often get spots but when I do this product works really well. Best I have found and good value for money.
These work well for early-stage spots‚Äîflatten them overnight and stop me picking. Super discreet and stay on all night. I have also worn under make up in the day and you really can't see them
I love this cleanser. If you have an oily skin with blackheads go for it you won't be disappointed.
I love this cleanser. If you have an oily skin with blackheads go for it you won't be disappointed.
I love this cleanser. If you have an oily skin with blackheads go for it you won't be disappointed.
I love this cleanser. If you have an oily skin with blackheads go for it you won't be disappointed.
My daughter love this product as it really helps her reduce the frequency of breakouts.
Great wash! Definitely great to double cleanse with. It is lightweight and easy to apply.

Spots adieu!!! This is a super charged serum that really makes a difference to your spots. Unless, they are very deep-seated Rosaceae spots, unfortunately... Those I have not been able to treat yet. My husband also doesn't like the smell on my face, but thankfully I don't mind it.
I thought this product worked pretty well. It burned for a second, but then it was fine on my skin.
Good product. Not drying and slowly unclog pores. I can use this with prescription retinoid
It probably is my 10th bottle and I still love it - clears my sensitive skin at night. No redness and definitly less pores and pimples.

i've been using this cleanser for years and it's the only product i've ever found that really clears up my oily skin. the difference in my skin (especially the blackheads on my nose) is night and day, and i can't imagine using anything else !
After using this, my whole face is so much cleaner and much less acne. The most useful one I've used so far.

Great product. I use it twice a day and it doesn't dry out my skin, or irritate it in anyway. Leaves it feeling soft and hydrated. Definitely notice an improvement in skin texture and the appearance of pores and blackheads. Love it!
I love love this cleanser, used it for a year and more, smooth glowy skin.
my blemish/pimple scars faded really quickly since i have it my routine

This is really amazing. I don't use it so much on my face (I did previously and still might, but luckily I don't get so many spots on my face anymore), more on my body where I occassionaly get pimples and body acne, and it helps to get rid of it quickly. One application and the redness, swelling and pain are pretty much gone, a few days and it's like nothing happened. Really reccommend!
For my skin type this is the best cleanser I've found. Leaves my skin feeling clean, but not dry. Has definitely helped with break outs too. I use it am and pm

I have acne-prone skin, and sometimes it even gets worse, but as I started using it, my skin calmed down, and I still get breakouts, but far less. And since it's my first cleanser, I hope I can review it better after using it completely.
I got this for my husband because he works construction and was getting a lot of blackheads around his nose and chin and hes seen a huge improvement from using this
Very effective facial cleanser for me. With this duo. One for home and one for during my travel.

My grandson's acne has been bad for years. Tried different brands of acne medication none worked till using this. They are not all gone yet but getting there. He uses it twice a day and they are no longer red and angry looking. Drying up nicely.
this is a great cleanser, doesn't dry skin and blackheads go away after a couple of uses

avis.titre: My daughters use these for their skin and love it
avis.texte: This cleanser helps the acne prone skin without drying out their skin.
This cleanser always works wonders for me, it helps to reduce blemishes and thoroughly cleans your face.

avis.titre: Helps to control open pores/ break outs.
avis.texte: Occasionally I get breakouts on my skin so I find that this cleanser is quite good at preventing and controlling them.
It has been one of the products that I use in my daily routine and it really is helping, my skin is so much better
Really cleans my face and definitely see improvement in my pores. Made me a bit pimply at first, but that soon stopped.

It has been one of the products that I use in my daily routine and it really is helping, my skin is so much better. The only think I don't really like is how difficult it is too get the product out of the bottle when there isn't much left

I love how gentle this cleanser is while still strong enough to help with preventing breakouts. I've already noticed a difference in my pore size and any breakouts I do get appear smaller in size than before. It also seems to help with redness around my breakouts.
Brought for my daughter and she loves it. Really helping clearing her skin without drying it out.

I now have very dry, perimenopausal skin, so I only use this on my nose and chin. I keep it in the shower and a bottle lasts for ages as you don't need much. Good for my ever increasingly large pores on my chin and blackheads on my nose, and I realise it's a bit off book but if I do have the odd spot or new blackhead, I can just put a tiny dab on at night, and by the morning it's gone. Without upsetting my skin. What more can you ask?
Great promotion! Whole family use this now and so constantly need this.

this is the only cleanser that has worked for my acne prone skin. when i use it every day, it keeps my blackheads under control. if a go a few days without it, i start to see crazy blackheads again, and small breakouts. i can't go without it!
I use this alongside the oatmeal cleanser. It keeps my black heads at bay and I'm really happy with it. Only a small amount is needed and my skin feels squeaky clean after use.
I haven't used it consistently so I can't really comment on it. From the use I have it does seem to calm the redness a bit.
Love it. As it controls my oiliness on skin. Reduce pimples, acne and break outs. Totally worth it.
The only cleanser I use, great for my sensitive, combination skin
Product didn't help with my breakouts until I changed to another salicylic acid cleanser. Won't be repurchasing
I have super sensitive skin but this is perfect for me I'm on my 5th bottle
I have combination skin and i suffered from acne from time to time however after consistently using the cleanser i noticed the acne disappearing gradually
This is great for the oily areas around my nose. I try to keep it away from other areas, as I'm older and concerned it could be too drying. But the finish it leaves is refreshing and clean.

avis.titre: Effective without drying, stripping or making me itch 👌
avis.texte: I love that I can use this daily to get oil, makeup 😉 and bacteria off of my skin, so it can breathe! I have super sensitive skin, mature, acne prone, oily skin and this product has dramatically decreased my breakouts, while keeping my skin soft and not overstripped. I adore my The INKEY List products and suggest them to people all the time!
The first couple times I used this treatment, I had great results! I use it just a couple times a week and haven't seen as much success since the first few uses
